blocks.text: British rock frontman Matty Healy and his wife, model-musician Gabbriette Bechtel, are reportedly expecting their first child together, just months after tying the knot. The news surfaced over the weekend after People obtained photographs of the couple out on a casual grocery run at Bristol Farms in West Hollywood, California.
